rule.statement: Section 187 of the Civil Procedure Code does not mandate the setting aside of a judgment if the trial Judge has properly analyzed the evidence and answers to the issues could be found in the body of the judgment.
rule.supporting_quote: 18. It is my view that where the trial Judge has properly analyzed the evidence and answers to the issues could be found in the body of the judgement, Section 187 does not mandate the setting aside of the judgement.
rule.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 187 of the Civil Procedure Code
